sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，于现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The trial was poised to be the most closely watched in Japanese history.
sentences.zh: 这场审判本有望成为日本历史上最受关注的一场。

sentences.en: A case involving claims of corporate greed, wounded national pride, and a rigged legal system.
sentences.zh: 这起案件涉及对企业贪婪、受伤的国家自豪感以及被操纵的法律体系的指控。

sentences.en: Until the defendant pulled off an unimaginable escape.
sentences.zh: 直到被告上演了一场难以想象的逃亡。

sentences.en: Ben Dooley with the latest in the saga of Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 本·杜利带你了解卡洛斯·戈恩传奇故事的最新进展。

sentences.en: Tuesday, January 14th.
sentences.zh: 1月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: Ben, set the scene for us.
sentences.zh: 本，给我们还原一下当时的场景。

sentences.en: It's just before New Year's in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 那是在东京新年前夕。

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？

sentences.en: So, I'm fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 当时我正睡得正香。

sentences.en: It's about 7.30 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 大约早上7点半。

sentences.en: I'm expecting to have a very easy holiday.
sentences.zh: 我原本期待能过一个轻松的假期。

sentences.en: Now, government offices are all closed for a week.
sentences.zh: 现在，政府机关都放假一周了。

sentences.en: Nothing's happening in Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本什么事都没发生。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, my phone starts ringing.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我的电话开始响了。

sentences.en: And it rings and rings and rings.
sentences.zh: 而且响个不停。

sentences.en: And finally, I decide I better answer it.
sentences.zh: 最后，我决定还是接听一下。

sentences.en: When I pick it up, it's New York.
sentences.zh: 当我接起电话时，是纽约打来的。

sentences.en: And then when you say New York, you mean the feared editors of The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 当你说纽约时，你指的是《纽约时报》那些令人敬畏的编辑们。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The feared editors.
sentences.zh: 那些令人敬畏的编辑。

sentences.en: You never want to get an early morning phone call from New York.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想接到来自纽约的清晨电话。

sentences.en: It's never good news.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是什么好消息。

sentences.en: It means either something bad has happened because someone else did something that you need to be worried about, or you've made some terrible mistake.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要么发生了什么坏事，因为别人做了你需要担心的事情，要么你犯了什么可怕的错误。

sentences.en: And what they tell me is that
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我的是

sentences.en: Carlos Ghosn, the most famous criminal defendant in Japan, has just mysteriously disappeared and reappeared in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 日本最著名的刑事被告卡洛斯·戈恩刚刚神秘失踪，并在黎巴嫩重新现身。

sentences.en: Well, it's a story we're all talking about, the escape straight out of the movies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我们都在谈论的故事，一场宛如电影情节的逃亡。

sentences.en: The juiciest story of the new year, at least so far, is the...
sentences.zh: 新年里最劲爆的故事，至少目前为止，是……

sentences.en: An international cloak-and-dagger escape.
sentences.zh: 一场国际间谍式的逃亡。

sentences.en: Dramatic and mysterious escape of Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩戏剧性且神秘的逃亡。

sentences.en: Former Nissan CEO and chairman, Carlos Ghosn, has left Japan.
sentences.zh: 日产前首席执行官兼董事长卡洛斯·戈恩已经离开日本。

sentences.en: He's now in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 他现在在黎巴嫩。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, this is...
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是……

sentences.en: By magic.
sentences.zh: 像变魔术一样。

sentences.en: Extrude me.
sentences.zh: 失敬了。

sentences.en: Once a CEO, now an international fugitive.
sentences.zh: 曾经的首席执行官，如今的国际逃犯。

sentences.en: And, you know, my first reaction is, how could he possibly have done this?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的第一反应是，他怎么可能做到这一点？

sentences.en: You know, it seems like something out of a movie, you know, impossible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这看起来像是电影里的情节，你知道，不可能发生。

sentences.en: And then remind us who Carlos Ghosn is.
sentences.zh: 那么请提醒我们卡洛斯·戈恩是谁。

sentences.en: So, Carlos Ghosn is this legendary CEO who made his name by reviving Nissan, this Japanese company, one of the country's largest automakers.
sentences.zh: 所以，卡洛斯·戈恩是一位传奇的首席执行官，他通过复兴日产这家日本公司（该国最大的汽车制造商之一）而树立了自己的名声。

sentences.en: He took the company from essentially what he has recently called a dead company and brought it back to life.
sentences.zh: 他把这家公司从他最近称之为“垂死公司”的状态中拉了回来，使其重获新生。

sentences.en: And it was this miracle of a turnaround that made him famous in Japan and throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 正是这种堪称奇迹的扭亏为盈，让他闻名日本乃至全世界。

sentences.en: Carlos Ghosn is regarded as one of the most dazzling managers in the automotive business.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩被视为汽车行业中最耀眼的管理者之一。

sentences.en: He is a huge figure, not just in Japan, not just for Nissan, but in the car industry, which...
sentences.zh: 他是一个重量级人物，不仅在日本，不仅对日产而言，在整个汽车行业也是如此，这……

sentences.en: And he went on to become the CEO of Nissan and also the French automaker Renault.
sentences.zh: 他后来成为了日产以及法国汽车制造商雷诺的首席执行官。

sentences.en: He turned things around at Renault and then Nissan, where in 2005,
sentences.zh: 他扭转了雷诺的局面，然后是日产，在2005年，

sentences.en: Carlos Ghosn became the first person to run two Fortune 500 global companies at the same time.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩成为了第一位同时掌管两家财富世界500强全球公司的人。

sentences.en: And those two companies formed an alliance and became one of the world's largest automakers.
sentences.zh: 这两家公司结成联盟，成为了全球最大的汽车制造商之一。

sentences.en: It's sort of hard to overstate the significance of Ghosn to Nissan and to Renault and this alliance.
sentences.zh: 戈恩对日产、雷诺以及这个联盟的重要性，怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: And he just went from strength to strength, became this hugely popular figure in the corporate business world.
sentences.zh: 他一路顺风顺水，成为了企业商界备受欢迎的人物。

sentences.en: He's flying all around the world.
sentences.zh: 他飞往世界各地。

sentences.en: He has houses in different countries.
sentences.zh: 他在不同的国家拥有房产。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, out of the blue, November 2018, he lands at an airport in Tokyo and is arrested.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，2018年11月，毫无征兆地，他在东京的一个机场降落并被捕。

sentences.en: Nissan chairman Carlos Ghosn has been arrested for allegedly underreporting his income.
sentences.zh: 日产董事长卡洛斯·戈恩因涉嫌瞒报收入已被捕。

sentences.en: And over the following several months, he's charged with four counts of financial wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几个月里，他被控四项财务违规罪名。

sentences.en: The internal probe by the Japanese automaker found multiple violations, including salary fraud and personal use of company assets.
sentences.zh: 这家日本汽车制造商的内部调查发现了多起违规行为，包括薪酬欺诈和个人使用公司资产。

sentences.en: Essentially, prosecutors say that he was trying to enrich himself for the company.
sentences.zh: 基本上，检察官表示他试图中饱私囊。

sentences.en: So that's the situation he finds himself in.
sentences.zh: 这就是他目前的处境。

sentences.en: He's facing trial on these four charges when he flees from Japan to Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 他面临这四项指控的审判，这时他从日本逃到了黎巴嫩。

sentences.en: And what's the answer to that question you have of how this happened?
sentences.zh: 对于这件事情是怎么发生的，你有什么答案？

sentences.en: What's the story?
sentences.zh: 故事是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, first, it's important to understand that he's under house arrest, but it's not super strict.
sentences.zh: 首先，重要的是要明白他在软禁中，但并不是超级严格。

sentences.en: I mean, he goes out to dinners, he travels to Kyoto.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他出去吃晚餐，去京都旅游。

sentences.en: So he's been able to move around fairly easily.
sentences.zh: 所以他能够相当轻松地四处移动。

sentences.en: But as best as we can tell from our reporting and from local media and government statements is on December 29th, he walks out of his home in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 但根据我们的报道以及当地媒体和政府声明，我们能拼凑出的最好结果是，12月29日，他走出了位于东京的家。

sentences.en: This is a two-story, fairly large home in central Tokyo in a swanky neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋位于东京市中心高档社区的两层较大住宅。

sentences.en: And there are three cameras above the door that were installed by the prosecutors to keep a watch on him.
sentences.zh: 门上方有三个摄像头，是检察官安装用来监视他的。

sentences.en: And he just strolls out.
sentences.zh: 而他就这样闲庭信步般走了出去。

sentences.en: He's got a face mask on, like a surgical mask, the kind of thing that people typically wear here to stop themselves from getting sick or stop other people from getting sick.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一个口罩，比如医用口罩，那种人们通常在这里戴着以防自己生病或阻止别人生病的口罩。

sentences.en: He's got a hat, black clothes, and he walks out to a nearby hotel.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶帽子，穿着一身黑衣，步行到附近的一家酒店。

sentences.en: He meets two men there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里遇到了两个人。

sentences.en: And they get on a bullet train to Osaka, which is a city to the southwest of Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 他们搭乘新干线前往大阪，那是东京西南方向的一个城市。

sentences.en: They're on the train for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 他们在火车上呆了大约两个小时。

sentences.en: They get off the train.
sentences.zh: 他们下了火车。

sentences.en: They walk into a hotel.
sentences.zh: 他们走进了一家酒店。

sentences.en: And then the two men walk out without Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 然后这两个人走出来时，没有带卡洛斯·戈恩。

sentences.en: But what they have is these two boxes, two large boxes.
sentences.zh: 但他们拿着这两个箱子，两个大箱子。

sentences.en: And the boxes have been described as sort of boxes for holding audio equipment, maybe like speakers or kinds of things you might see roadies carrying at a concert.
sentences.zh: 这些箱子被形容为某种存放音频设备的箱子，可能像是扬声器，或者你在音乐会上可能会看到舞台工作人员携带的那种东西。

sentences.en: And these two men take these boxes to the Kansai International Airport, to the private jet terminal.
sentences.zh: 这两个人把这些箱子带到了关西国际机场的私人喷气机航站楼。

sentences.en: And the boxes are too big to go through the luggage screening.
sentences.zh: 这些箱子太大了，无法通过行李安检。

sentences.en: So they're not screened.
sentences.zh: 所以它们没有经过安检。

sentences.en: You know, keep in mind, it's almost New Year's.
sentences.zh: 你知道，记住，快到新年了。

sentences.en: People are off their guard.
sentences.zh: 人们都放松了警惕。

sentences.en: You know, they're not really that interested in checking to see what's in these boxes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们其实并没有太大兴趣去检查这些箱子里有什么。

sentences.en: You know, they're just kind of relaxing and looking forward to their holiday.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们只是在放松，期待着他们的假期。

sentences.en: And these men just wheel these boxes right onto the plane, a private jet that's waiting there.
sentences.zh: 而这些人只是把这些箱子直接推上了飞机，一架正在那里等待的私人喷气机。

sentences.en: And the plane takes off.
sentences.zh: 飞机起飞了。

sentences.en: And in one of those boxes, we believe, is Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，其中一个箱子里装着卡洛斯·戈恩。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So Japan's most famous criminal defendant flees the country in an audio box.
sentences.zh: 所以日本最著名的刑事被告用一个音响箱逃离了国家。

sentences.en: That's what we think happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们认为发生的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, what you're describing feels both very simple and extremely elaborate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你所描述的既让人觉得非常简单，又极其精心策划。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, you know, this was not something that he did by himself with two friends.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，你知道，这不是他自己和两个朋友就能做到的事情。

sentences.en: This is something that took a lot of resources, a lot of planning.
sentences.zh: 这是一件需要大量资源、大量规划的事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's something that he's famous for is being this detail-oriented planner and someone who likes to manage lots of people, like big teams of people.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他出名的原因之一就是他是一个注重细节的规划者，一个喜欢管理很多人、比如大型团队的人。

sentences.en: You know, so you can imagine this was a pretty complex operation, even if the execution was simple.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以你可以想象这是一个相当复杂的行动，即使执行起来很简单。

sentences.en: Ben, after all of that detailed planning and this escape, why is he going to Lebanon, of all places?
sentences.zh: 本，在经过所有这些详细的规划和这次逃亡之后，他为什么偏偏要去黎巴嫩？

sentences.en: Well, he had three passports.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他有三本护照。

sentences.en: He was a citizen of Brazil, France, and Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 他是巴西、法国和黎巴嫩的公民。

sentences.en: And Lebanon was the closeSt.
sentences.zh: 而黎巴嫩是最近的。

sentences.en: It doesn't have an extradition treaty with Japan, which means that the Lebanese government will never send him back to Japan to face a trial.
sentences.zh: 它与日本没有引渡条约，这意味着黎巴嫩政府永远不会把他送回日本受审。

sentences.en: And he's something of a national hero in Lebanon, so he could expect a hero's welcome.
sentences.zh: 而且他在黎巴嫩算是一个民族英雄，所以他可以期待英雄般的欢迎。

sentences.en: So what's the reaction back in Tokyo once word trickles back that he has pulled this off?
sentences.zh: 那么，当消息传回东京，得知他成功完成了这一切时，各方有什么反应？

sentences.en: Silence.
sentences.zh: 沉默。

sentences.en: Absolute silence.
sentences.zh: 绝对的沉默。

sentences.en: They're caught completely off guard.
sentences.zh: 他们完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: But behind that silence, there's sort of an embarrassment that the prosecutors have allowed the country's most famous criminal defendant to slip through their fingers.
sentences.zh: 但在这种沉默背后，有一种尴尬，因为检察官竟然让这个国家最著名的刑事被告从他们的眼皮底下溜走了。

sentences.en: And some outrage, even among people who supported him, there was a sense that he'd gone too far and that he should have stayed in Japan to defend himself.
sentences.zh: 还有一些愤怒，甚至在支持他的人当中，也有人觉得他太过分了，他本应该留在日本为自己辩护。

sentences.en: That would have been the most appropriate thing for him to do.
sentences.zh: 那对他来说才是最合适的事情。

sentences.en: And Ben, what are you doing at this point?
sentences.zh: 本，这时候你在做什么？

sentences.en: Because a story that I assume you are very much responsible for has literally just up and left the country that you cover.
sentences.zh: 因为我猜你负责的这个新闻故事，字面意思上刚刚拍拍屁股离开你所报道的国家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, you know, suddenly this story that I was hugely responsible for when I was supposed to be taking a vacation just appears in my lap.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，突然之间，这个我原本负有重大责任、而且本该在休假的故事就这么落在了我的腿上。

sentences.en: And I'm just frantically calling as many people as I can, you know, getting in touch with his PR team, his lawyers, you know,
sentences.zh: 我正疯狂地给尽可能多的人打电话，你知道，联系他的公关团队、他的律师，你知道，

sentences.en: various people that I've spoken to over the previous year about his case.
sentences.zh: 各种我在过去一年里跟他案子有过交流的人。

sentences.en: He's pretty much anyone I can think of.
sentences.zh: 基本上任何我能想到的人。

sentences.en: And the big question I have is, now that he's free, is he going to talk?
sentences.zh: 我最大的问题是，既然他自由了，他会开口说话吗？

sentences.en: And if so, will he talk to us?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，他会跟我们谈谈吗？

sentences.en: And then I get a phone call.
sentences.zh: 然后我接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: And someone asked me, if Carlos Ghosn is willing to talk to you, would you be able to get on a plane to Lebanon?
sentences.zh: 有人问我，如果卡洛斯·戈恩愿意跟你谈谈，你能马上坐飞机去黎巴嫩吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And I said, of course.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然可以。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而不需要输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, so Ben, Carlos Ghosn is willing to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么本，卡洛斯·戈恩愿意和你谈谈。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So I go online and I buy a last-minute ticket to Beirut.
sentences.zh: 于是我上网买了一张去贝鲁特的末班机票。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm frantically packing, get all my stuff in order, run to Haneida Airport, jump on the plane.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我正疯狂地收拾行李，把我的东西都整理好，跑到羽田机场，跳上飞机。

sentences.en: And 23 hours later, I touch down in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 23小时后，我在黎巴嫩着陆。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a long flight.
sentences.zh: 飞行时间挺长的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: Well, there's a layover in Paris, so that wasn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在巴黎转机，所以倒也还好。

sentences.en: I had a croissant and some coffee.
sentences.zh: 我吃了块牛角面包，喝了点咖啡。

sentences.en: So I'm in Lebanon, and I'm preparing to talk to Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 现在我到了黎巴嫩，正准备去采访卡洛斯·戈恩。

sentences.en: But before I get to sit down with him, first, there's this news conference that he's scheduled.
sentences.zh: 但在我和他坐下来谈之前，他先安排了一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: So we're in an Uber heading towards Press Club, where we're going to see Carlos Ghosn give his first press conference since he was arrested in November of 2018.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正坐着优步前往记者俱乐部，卡洛斯·戈恩将在那里召开他自2018年11月被捕以来的首场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: It's a rainy day today.
sentences.zh: 今天是个雨天。

sentences.en: Traffic's pretty intense.
sentences.zh: 交通相当拥堵。

sentences.en: So I and one of my colleagues from the Beirut Bureau go to a press club where the conference is going to be held.
sentences.zh: 我和贝鲁特分社的一位同事前往将要举行发布会的记者俱乐部。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: We've just arrived at the venue.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到会场。

sentences.en: And we get there, and it's just chaos.
sentences.zh: 我们一到那儿，现场简直一片混乱。

sentences.en: We're going to go.
sentences.zh: 我们要进去了。

sentences.en: I mean, there are hundreds of reporters.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有几百名记者。

sentences.en: They're all clamoring to get in.
sentences.zh: 他们都在争先恐后地往里挤。

sentences.en: People are screaming, shouting, pushing.
sentences.zh: 人们在尖叫、大喊、推搡。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: We're heading through security into the venue.
sentences.zh: 我们正通过安检进入会场。

sentences.en: Got some guy with a guard dog here.
sentences.zh: 这里有个带着警犬的家伙。

sentences.en: Tension's running a little bit high here.
sentences.zh: 这里的气氛有点紧张。

sentences.en: There are armed guards, you know, with dogs and TV trucks everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是带狗的武装警卫和电视转播车。

sentences.en: Sorry, we're on the list here.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我们在名单上。

sentences.en: No time.
sentences.zh: 没时间了。

sentences.en: And we get inside.
sentences.zh: 我们进去了。

sentences.en: And we go upstairs, and we walk into this big, empty white room with chairs lined up.
sentences.zh: 我们上楼，走进了这个摆满椅子的大型空旷白色房间。

sentences.en: There are about 100 reporters there from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 那里大约有100名来自世界各地的记者。

sentences.en: I think this is what's usually referred to as a media circus.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是通常所说的媒体马戏团吧。

sentences.en: And they're all waiting to hear what Carlos Ghosn has to say.
sentences.zh: 他们都在等着听卡洛斯·戈恩说些什么。

sentences.en: So he's about to walk in.
sentences.zh: 所以他快要进来了。

sentences.en: We're asking him, yep, he's walking in.
sentences.zh: 我们正问着呢，对，他进来了。

sentences.en: He's with his wife, Carol.
sentences.zh: 他和他的妻子卡罗尔在一起。

sentences.en: And when he comes in, people just swarm him.
sentences.zh: 他一进来，人们就蜂拥而上。

sentences.en: It's a crush of reporters.
sentences.zh: 记者们挤作一团。

sentences.en: All the cameramen and photographers are pushing up, trying to get a good shot of him as he walks into the room.
sentences.zh: 所有摄影师和摄像师都在往前挤，想在他走进房间时拍到一张好照片。

sentences.en: Flash bulbs are going off, and everyone's just crowded around him.
sentences.zh: 闪光灯闪个不停，所有人都围在他周围。

sentences.en: So it's pretty exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以这挺令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: I've been writing about this guy for almost a year now.
sentences.zh: 我写这个家伙的文章快一年了。

sentences.en: It's the first time I've actually seen him in the flesh.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次见到他的真人。

sentences.en: So he looks healthy.
sentences.zh: 他看起来气色不错。

sentences.en: He's got a nice black suit on, red tie.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件漂亮的黑色西装，系着红领带。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, he's the picture of a CEO.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，他就是首席执行官的化身。

sentences.en: So no worse for the wear.
sentences.zh: 所以毫发无损。

sentences.en: You wouldn't know it.
sentences.zh: 你根本看不出来。

sentences.en: And he walks up to the lectern, and the show starts.
sentences.zh: 他走上讲台，好戏开场了。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, I want to thank you for taking the time to be here.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，我要感谢大家拨冗出席。

sentences.en: It's everything that he's been saving up for the last year.
sentences.zh: 这全都是他这一年来憋在心里的东西。

sentences.en: As you can imagine, today is a very important day for me.
sentences.zh: 正如你们所想象的，今天对我来说是非常重要的一天。

sentences.en: One that I have looked forward to every single day for more than 400 days.
sentences.zh: 这是我400多天来，每一天都在期盼的一天。

sentences.en: He just is taking the opportunity to explain himself, what happened to him, his whole story.
sentences.zh: 他只是借此机会解释自己、他的遭遇以及他的整个故事。

sentences.en: Since I was brutally taken from my world as I knew it, ripped from my family, my friends, my communities, from Renault, Nissan, and Mitsubishi,
sentences.zh: 自从我被残忍地剥夺了我所熟悉的世界，与我的家人、朋友、社区，与雷诺、日产和三菱分离，

sentences.en: and the 450,000 women and men who comprise those companies.
sentences.zh: 以及组成这些公司的45万名员工分离。

sentences.en: And he starts walking us through his history with Nissan.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始向我们梳理他与日产的历史。

sentences.en: A brand which was nowhere in 1999, which became one of the top 60 brands in the world.
sentences.zh: 一个在1999年默默无闻，后来却成为全球前60大品牌的企业。

sentences.en: And how he turned it around.
sentences.zh: 以及他是如何扭转乾坤的。

sentences.en: And the amazing success that the company had while he was CEO.
sentences.zh: 还有在他担任首席执行官期间公司取得的惊人成功。

sentences.en: You know, a CEO is here as long as he perforMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，首席执行官只要有业绩就能一直干下去。

sentences.en: I didn't say 17 years ahead of Nissan because I was there only because I was performing.
sentences.zh: 我在日产待了17年可不是因为别的，只是因为我有业绩。

sentences.en: I was delivering growth.
sentences.zh: 我在创造增长。

sentences.en: I was delivering profit.
sentences.zh: 我在创造利润。

sentences.en: I was delivering cash flow.
sentences.zh: 我在创造现金流。

sentences.en: I was delivering dividends.
sentences.zh: 我在创造股息。

sentences.en: And then he starts to talk about the arreSt.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始谈论被捕的事。

sentences.en: I was arrested on November 19, 2018.
sentences.zh: 我于2018年11月19日被捕。

sentences.en: And how it happened.
sentences.zh: 以及事情是如何发生的。

sentences.en: I didn't suspect anything.
sentences.zh: 我毫无察觉。

sentences.en: And how he was completely caught off guard.
sentences.zh: 以及他是如何完全被打了个措手不及的。

sentences.en: Some people ask me, oh my God, you didn't look at this?
sentences.zh: 有些人问我，天哪，你没注意到这个吗？

sentences.en: You didn't mention this?
sentences.zh: 你没提到这个吗？

sentences.en: You didn't suspect this?
sentences.zh: 你没怀疑过吗？

sentences.en: And I say, you know, what happened in Pearl Harbor?
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，珍珠港事件是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Did you see Pearl Harbor happening?
sentences.zh: 你预见到珍珠港事件会发生了吗？

sentences.en: He says it was like Pearl Harbor.
sentences.zh: 他说这就像珍珠港事件一样。

sentences.en: Did you see Pearl Harbor happening?
sentences.zh: 你预见到珍珠港事件会发生了吗？

sentences.en: Did you notice what happened in Pearl Harbor?
sentences.zh: 你注意到珍珠港发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: He says his arrest was like the sneak attack from Japan that led the United States into World War II.
sentences.zh: 他说他的被捕就像日本发动偷袭导致美国卷入第二次世界大战一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全如此。

sentences.en: He said he had no idea what was coming.
sentences.zh: 他说他根本不知道灾难即将降临。

sentences.en: And I didn't notice it because it is true that when it's planned and it's confidential and it's secret, what happens?
sentences.zh: 我没有察觉到，因为当事情经过策划、高度保密且神不知鬼不觉时，确实会这样，不是吗？

sentences.en: And you'll be surprised.
sentences.zh: 你会感到惊讶的。

sentences.en: And I was surprised.
sentences.zh: 而我也确实感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And then he starts to go through all of the charges against him.
sentences.zh: 随后他开始逐一反驳针对他的所有指控。

sentences.en: The first accusation is the under-reporting.
sentences.zh: 第一项指控是瞒报收入。

sentences.en: This is the main accusation for which I was arrested.
sentences.zh: 这是我被捕的主要指控。

sentences.en: And he's got slides.
sentences.zh: 他准备了幻灯片。

sentences.en: He's projecting documents on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他在墙上投影文件。

sentences.en: You know, I think we have the liSt. Yeah, we have here the liSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我们有清单。对，我们这有清单。

sentences.en: You know, getting way into the weeds of these issues, frankly, trying to litigate them in front of this audience.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，陷入这些问题的细枝末节中，试图在这些观众面前为自己辩护。

sentences.en: We continue.
sentences.zh: 我们继续。

sentences.en: This is another one.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个。

sentences.en: And people at this point are starting to get a little antsy.
sentences.zh: 此时人们开始有点坐立不安了。

sentences.en: You know, they're starting to have conversations behind me because you can't read the documents.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们开始在我身后窃窃私语，因为根本看不清那些文件。

sentences.en: And even if you could, there's no way that we were in a position to judge, you know, what they actually said about the charges against him.
sentences.zh: 退一步讲，就算你看得清，我们也根本没有立场去评判这些文件关于针对他的指控到底说了些什么。

sentences.en: But the larger point he's trying to make is that this is a stitch-up.
sentences.zh: 但他想要表达的更核心的观点是，这是一场陷害。

sentences.en: But obviously, I didn't know that Islam was behind him.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，我当时并不知道伊斯兰在他身后。

sentences.en: And it was all staged way before between the prosecutor and the company.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是检察官和公司事先策划好的。

sentences.en: That all the charges against him are completely political.
sentences.zh: 针对他的所有指控完全都是政治性的。

sentences.en: They're made up.
sentences.zh: 都是捏造的。

sentences.en: And he's saying that the reason why the Japanese government brought these charges against them is basically because he wounded their national pride.
sentences.zh: 他说日本政府之所以对提出这些指控，主要是因为他伤害了他们的民族自尊心。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what's his argument for how he did that?
sentences.zh: 那他对此的论据是什么呢？

sentences.en: So, basically, it comes down to the idea that as the head of Renault, he had been tasked by the French government to make the alliance between Renault and Nissan stronger.
sentences.zh: 所以，归根结底就是这种观点：作为雷诺的负责人，他受法国政府委托，要让雷诺和日产的联盟更加稳固。

sentences.en: To make the alliance so strong that the two companies would never be able to be separated.
sentences.zh: 要让这个联盟稳固到两家公司再也无法被分拆的地步。

sentences.en: And this was seen in Japan, he argues, as essentially an attempt to take one of the crown jewels of Japan's auto industry.
sentences.zh: 他认为，在日本看来，这本质上是企图夺走日本汽车工业的明珠之一。

sentences.en: And turn it into a French company.
sentences.zh: 并把它变成一家法国公司。

sentences.en: And if this were to have gone through, the argument was, then France would be in control of one of Japan's biggest and most important companies.
sentences.zh: 争论的焦点在于，如果这一计划得以实施，那么法国将控制日本最大、最重要的公司之一。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there was no truSt.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，彼此缺乏信任。

sentences.en: And that was something that the Japanese government and certain people at Nissan were just unwilling to allow to happen.
sentences.zh: 这是日本政府和日产某些人绝不允许发生的事情。

sentences.en: And some of our Japanese friends thought, the only way to get rid of the influence of Renault on Nissan is to get rid of me.
sentences.zh: 我们的一些日本朋友认为，摆脱雷诺对日产影响的唯一方法就是除掉我。

sentences.en: So he says that the crime he committed, which it sounds like he doesn't think is a crime at all,
sentences.zh: 所以他说他犯下的罪行——听起来他认为这根本不算罪行——

sentences.en: is taking a Japanese brand and making it less Japanese and offending the people and the government of Japan in the process.
sentences.zh: 就是把一个日本品牌变得不再那么日本化，并在过程中冒犯了日本人民和政府。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he says that was not at all his plan.
sentences.zh: 他说这绝对不是他的计划。

sentences.en: But that was the fear.
sentences.zh: 但这正是他们所恐惧的。

sentences.en: And that's what led to his downfall.
sentences.zh: 而这正是导致他倒台的原因。

sentences.en: According to Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 根据卡洛斯·戈恩的说法。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Let me continue.
sentences.zh: 我继续说。

sentences.en: 130 days in prison.
sentences.zh: 在监狱里度过130天。

sentences.en: Solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 单独监禁。

sentences.en: Tiny cell without window.
sentences.zh: 没有窗户的狭小单人牢房。

sentences.en: And he also went into detail about his experience in the Japanese justice system.
sentences.zh: 他还详细讲述了自己在日本司法系统中的遭遇。

sentences.en: Shower twice a week.
sentences.zh: 一周洗两次澡。

sentences.en: Tried to ask to have more.
sentences.zh: 试图申请增加次数。

sentences.en: They said no.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Prescribed medication is forbidden.
sentences.zh: 禁止服用处方药。

sentences.en: You can get only the medicine from the prison.
sentences.zh: 只能服用监狱提供的药物。

sentences.en: How he had spent, you know, more than 130 days in a Japanese jail, waiting to get on bail.
sentences.zh: 他是如何在日产监狱里度过130多天等待保释的。

sentences.en: During that time, he had been interrogated by prosecutors without his lawyer from 7 to 11 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，检察官每天对他进行7到11个小时的审讯，且没有他的律师在场。

sentences.en: And even once he got out of jail, there were these restrictions put on his daily life.
sentences.zh: 即使他出了监狱，他的日常生活也受到了种种限制。

sentences.en: And the most egregious one for him, he said, was that he wasn't allowed to meet his wife.
sentences.zh: 对她而言最过分的是，他说他被禁止与妻子见面。

sentences.en: And the question was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这个问题非常有趣。

sentences.en: It was saying, why do they want to meet?
sentences.zh: 意思是，为什么他们想见面？

sentences.en: And you say, OK, how about a Zoom, a conference?
sentences.zh: 你会说，好吧，那开个Zoom会议总行吧？

sentences.en: He said, what do they want to talk about?
sentences.zh: 他说，他们到底想聊什么？

sentences.en: And Japanese prosecutors had essentially said that they believed that if he were allowed to speak to her, might tamper with evidence, might try to get to witnesses in the case.
sentences.zh: 日本检察官基本上表示，他们认为如果允许他与妻子通话，可能会串供，可能会试图接触案件中的证人。

sentences.en: And, you know, his argument is, well, that's ridiculous because if I wanted to do that, I could have done that through anyone.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的反驳是，这太荒谬了，因为如果我想这么做，我可以透过任何人去做。

sentences.en: I didn't have to use my wife.
sentences.zh: 我没必要非得用我的妻子。

sentences.en: So the only reason why they were forbidding me from seeing her was because they were punishing me.
sentences.zh: 所以他们禁止我见她的唯一原因，就是为了惩罚我。

sentences.en: Because they knew that by not allowing me to have a normal life, they were breaking me.
sentences.zh: 因为他们知道，通过不让我过正常的生活，他们就能击垮我。

sentences.en: That they were trying to squeeze a confession out of him.
sentences.zh: 他们试图逼迫他招供。

sentences.en: And when he refused to confess to the crimes they had charged him with, they threatened to make his life a living hell.
sentences.zh: 当他拒绝承认被指控的罪名时，他们威胁要让他的生活生不如死。

sentences.en: I felt like I was not a human anymore.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己不再像个人了。

sentences.en: So he said that all these elements add up to create a system of justice that was rigged against him.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，所有这些因素加在一起，构建了一个对准他的司法体系。

sentences.en: And that he had no chance of ever getting a fair trial in Japan.
sentences.zh: 他在日本根本没有机会得到公正的审判。

sentences.en: And that's why he felt he had to escape.
sentences.zh: 这就是他觉得必须逃跑的原因。

sentences.en: And Ben, as you're sitting there, hearing Carlos go and make these arguments, what are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 本，当你坐在那里，听着卡洛斯阐述这些观点时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: And do they sound accurate and truthful?
sentences.zh: 这些听起来准确且真实吗？

sentences.en: Or do they sound highly disputable?
sentences.zh: 还是说它们听起来极具争议？

sentences.en: It's impossible to say at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前还很难说。

sentences.en: We haven't seen any of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们还没看到任何证据。

sentences.en: And I think if you were to ask the prosecutors, they would say, this is a man who lied to Nissan's shareholders.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你去问检察官，他们会说，这是一个对日产股东撒谎的男人。

sentences.en: This is a man who enriched himself at the company's expense.
sentences.zh: 这是一个以牺牲公司利益为代价来 enriquecer（发家致富）自己的男人。

sentences.en: And it's just impossible to know what the truth is at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前根本无法知道真相是什么。

sentences.en: Right, because he fled the country before the trial.
sentences.zh: 对，因为他在审判前逃离了该国。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: I left Japan because I wanted justice.
sentences.zh: 我离开日本是因为我想要正义。

sentences.en: That's why I left Japan.
sentences.zh: 这就是我离开日本的原因。

sentences.en: I didn't run from justice.
sentences.zh: 我没有逃避正义。

sentences.en: I want justice.
sentences.zh: 我想要正义。

sentences.en: Because justice is the only way I want to establish my reputation.
sentences.zh: 因为正义是我恢复名誉的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And the only way what I've done during my life is going to be recognized to its value.
sentences.zh: 也是我一生所做的事情得到应有价值认可的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And if I don't get it in Japan, I'm going to get it somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 如果我在日本得不到，我就去别的地方得到。

sentences.en: Thank you for your attention.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的关注。

sentences.en: So, Carlos Ghosn finishes up his presentation.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩的演讲结束了。

sentences.en: And he moves into the question and answer section.
sentences.zh: 然后他进入了问答环节。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What you're going to try to do is go by region.
sentences.zh: 你接下来要做的是按地区提问。

sentences.en: And he starts answering questions in four different languages.
sentences.zh: 他开始用四种不同的语言回答问题。

sentences.en: I will not ask you to be asked.
sentences.zh: 我不会要求你被提问。

sentences.en: He's speaking Arabic, which is the language he spoke at home with his parents.
sentences.zh: 他说阿拉伯语，这是他小时候在家和父母说的语言。

sentences.en: He's speaking Portuguese, which is the language of the country who was born, Brazil.
sentences.zh: 他说葡萄牙语，这是他出生的国家巴西的语言。

sentences.en: He's speaking French, the language of the country who was educated, and, of course, in English.
sentences.zh: 他说法语，这是他受过教育的国家的语言，当然，还有英语。

sentences.en: And I'm just watching him flawlessly move from language to language, answering these questions from reporters around the world.
sentences.zh: 我看着他天衣无缝地在不同语言之间切换，回答来自世界各地记者的提问。

sentences.en: And, you know, it occurs to me as I'm watching, it's an incredible performance.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看着看着我突然觉得，这是一场不可思议的表演。

sentences.en: And it says a lot about this guy's identity.
sentences.zh: 这也很大程度上反映了这个家伙的身份认同。

sentences.en: He's this transnational business person who essentially doesn't belong to any one nation.
sentences.zh: 他是那种本质上不属于任何特定国家的跨国商人。

sentences.en: He lives in this almost kind of like gray area, you know, between nation states.
sentences.zh: 他生活在差不多可以说是民族国家之间那种灰色地带，你知道的。

sentences.en: And there's something about it that it seems is really essential to the case against him and how he's responded to it.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，这似乎对针对他的案件以及他对此的反应至关重要。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, he believes that the charges against him were brought by the Japanese because he is not Japanese.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他认为日本对他的指控是因为他不是日本人。

sentences.en: So there's that on one hand.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面是这样。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, also, he feels like he's not beholden to Japanese justice.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他也觉得自己不受日本司法管辖的约束。

sentences.en: As this person with passports from Brazil and France and Lebanon and houses around the world and connections and networks that span the globe,
sentences.zh: 作为一个拥有巴西、法国和黎巴嫩护照、在世界各地拥有房产以及全球范围内人脉网络的人，

sentences.en: he doesn't feel like he has to subject himself to Japanese justice.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己不必让自己受制于日本的司法。

sentences.en: He believes that he can make the choice to just get up and leave, to disappear.
sentences.zh: 他相信自己可以做出选择，直接起身离开、消失。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So whether or not this tactic can ever seem justified or not justified,
sentences.zh: 所以，不管这种战术在什么时候看起来是否正当，

sentences.en: the message that Carlos Ghosn is sending by fleeing his trial in Japan is that if you're a global CEO and you are well-connected and you have resources,
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩通过逃离他在日本的审判所传达的信息是，如果你是一个全球首席执行官，而且你人脉广阔、资源丰富，

sentences.en: you get to choose which country's legal system you can abide by, which ones you're willing to participate in, and which ones you plan an elaborate escape from, right?
sentences.zh: 你就可以选择遵守哪个国家的法律体系，愿意参与哪个国家的法律体系，以及计划从哪个国家精心策划逃跑，对吧？

sentences.en: Which basically boils down to not really feeling accountable to any one country.
sentences.zh: 这基本上归结为对任何单一国家都没有真正的责任感。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was a question that was bothering me, and I really wanted to ask him about it.
sentences.zh: 这个问题一直困扰着我，我真的很想问问他。

sentences.en: And I finally got the chance after the press conference ended, and I got to sit down with him one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 新闻发布会结束后，我终于有机会和他进行了面对面的独家坐谈。

sentences.en: We went upstairs, and I tried to set up the fancy recorder you guys made me buy, and I messed it up.
sentences.zh: 我们上楼去，我试图安装你们让我买的高级录音机，结果弄砸了。

sentences.en: So we didn't get the whole interview, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 所以不幸的是，我们没有录下完整的采访。

sentences.en: But we forgive you.
sentences.zh: 不过我们原谅你。

sentences.en: It had been a long week.
sentences.zh: 那真是漫长的一周。

sentences.en: It had been a long week.
sentences.zh: 那真是漫长的一周。

sentences.en: And I sat down with him, and I asked him that question.
sentences.zh: 我坐下来，向他提出了那个问题。

sentences.en: You know, we probably will have people listening or reading or thinking to themselves that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可能会有听众、读者或人们心里在想，

sentences.en: okay, maybe the Japanese justice system is rigged, but the only reason why you could do this is because you're a person of wealth.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许日本的司法系统是被操纵的，但你之所以能做到这一点，唯一的理由就是你是个有钱人。

sentences.en: You know, you have power connections.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你有权势人脉。

sentences.en: And that's what allowed you to escape Japan.
sentences.zh: 这就是让你得以逃离日本的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, is that fair?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: Let you put it the other way.
sentences.zh: 换个角度来说。

sentences.en: Let you put it the other way.
sentences.zh: 换个角度来说。

sentences.en: And, you know, he kind of danced around the question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他有点在问题周围兜圈子。

sentences.en: But he came down, basically, on the idea that the Japanese system is rigged.
sentences.zh: 但他基本上还是归结为日本体制是被操纵的这一观点。

sentences.en: So, back to your question, yes, at the end of the day, I fell in a trap.
sentences.zh: 所以，回到你的问题，是的，说到底，我落入了一个陷阱。

sentences.en: You know, found a way out, which requires resources, and contacts, no doubt about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，找到了出路，这无疑需要资源和人脉。

sentences.en: But the protection is not to have money.
sentences.zh: 但保护伞不是有钱。

sentences.en: The protection is avoid going in places where you can't fall into a trap like this.
sentences.zh: 保护伞是避免去那些你会落入这种陷阱的地方。

sentences.en: And I think it's my responsibility today to tell all the foreigners who are in Japan, be careful.
sentences.zh: 我认为我今天的责任是告诉所有在日本的外国人，小心点。

sentences.en: That was the message that he wanted to convey to the world.
sentences.zh: 这就是他想向世界传达的信息。

sentences.en: And, you know, the great irony here is that he says he's searching for justice, but because of the decision that he made, he may never find it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里最大的讽刺在于，他说他在寻找正义，但由于他做出的决定，他可能永远也找不到正义了。

sentences.en: Because there's always going to be an asterisk next to this case.
sentences.zh: 因为这个案件永远会带有某种瑕疵或附加说明。

sentences.en: He's not going to be able to make his case fully, and the Japanese prosecutors are never going to be able to make it either.
sentences.zh: 他将无法充分陈述他的案情，日本检察官也无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: So, there's not going to be a real test of his innocence.
sentences.zh: 所以，不会对他的清白进行真正的审判。

sentences.en: But what he has done is he has let CEOs around the world know that this is an option.
sentences.zh: 但他所做的是，他让全世界的首席执行官都知道这是一种选择。

sentences.en: That if they don't like the justice in the country where they are, they can just get up and leave.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不喜欢他们所在国家的司法，他们随时可以起身离开。

sentences.en: Thank you, Ben.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，本。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, protests broke out in two major Iranian cities as citizens expressed outrage over the acknowledgement that their government shot down a passenger plane,
sentences.zh: 周一，伊朗两个主要城市爆发抗议活动，市民们对政府承认击落一架客机、

sentences.en: killing everyone on board.
sentences.zh: 导致机上所有人员遇难表示愤怒。

sentences.en: The protests against the government are a striking turnaround for Iran's leaders.
sentences.zh: 针对政府的抗议活动对伊朗领导人来说是一个惊人的转变。

sentences.en: Just a few days ago, hundreds of thousands of Iranians took to the streets in support of the government after the United States killed General Qasem Soleimani.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，在美国杀死苏莱曼尼将军后，数十万伊朗人走上街头支持政府。

sentences.en: Many of those protesting the downing of the plane are calling for accountability from the government, which had originally denied any role in the incident.
sentences.zh: 许多抗议击落客机事件的人要求政府承担责任，而政府最初曾否认在事件中有任何责任。

sentences.en: And Senator Cory Booker of New Jersey has dropped out of the Democratic race for president after failing to qualify for the next debate.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州参议员科里·布克因未能获得下一场辩论的资格，退出了民主党总统候选人初选。

sentences.en: He now joins Julian Castro and Marianne Williamson in quitting the race just before voting begins in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 他现在加入了朱利安·卡斯特罗和玛丽安·威廉姆森的行列，在艾奥瓦州投票开始前夕退出了竞选。

sentences.en: Polling shows a close race in Iowa, with Joe Biden in the lead.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，艾奥瓦州的竞选异常激烈，乔·拜登领先。

sentences.en: And the next three competitors, Bernie Sanders, Elizabeth Warren, and Pete Buttigieg, in a statistical tie.
sentences.zh: 而接下来的三位竞争者伯尼·桑德斯、伊丽莎白·沃伦和皮特·布蒂吉格处于统计上的平局。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们盘点如何筹备节日期间的聚会。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片才睡着的。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序上或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
